## Description

**What**: Add the sprint-report consumer for the `design:fidelity_gap` tag — the sprint reporting code path (Phase 9 / end-of-sprint summary, or equivalent in the sprint skill's reporting section) enumerates closed stories carrying `design:fidelity_gap` and lists them in a dedicated "Design fidelity gaps" section of the sprint report, with the artifact path to the diff image where available.

**Why**: SC-4 is conjunctive — both tagging AND sprint-report surfacing are required. Story 280d-e63c tags stories but explicitly defers sprint-report surfacing as out of scope: "Sprint report surfacing of design:fidelity_gap is deferred — sprint skill has no consumer code for it yet. Track as follow-up." Without this story, SC-4 is structurally unsatisfiable.

**Scope**:
- IN: Sprint report rendering enumeration of `design:fidelity_gap`-tagged stories; dedicated section listing story ID, title, diff-artifact path; non-blocking semantics; integration test seeding a tagged story and asserting it appears in the rendered report
- OUT: Modifications to the tagging side (owned by 280d-e63c); changes to the design fidelity score formula; introducing additional sprint-report sections beyond fidelity gaps

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, sprint report rendering enumerates closed stories carrying `design:fidelity_gap` and lists them in a dedicated section with story ID, title, and diff-artifact path when available
  ← Satisfies: sc-4  (sc-4: "story tagged design:fidelity_gap AND surfaced in sprint reports")
- When this story is complete, an integration test seeds a closed story with `design:fidelity_gap`, runs sprint report rendering, and asserts the story appears in the "Design fidelity gaps" section
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, sprint report rendering with zero `design:fidelity_gap`-tagged stories produces a coherent report (section omitted or empty, per the chosen design)
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, surfacing is non-blocking: closure of `design:fidelity_gap`-tagged stories continues to proceed without intervention
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Read first] Read sprint skill's reporting section (plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md) before implementation — the consumer location depends on the existing report-rendering structure
- [Coordination] Not amendable into 280d-e63c (which has explicitly deferred this scope); standalone story is required
- [Artifacts] Diff-artifact path resolution should reuse the design artifacts directory contract established by 280d-e63c (designs/{uuid}/validation/)
- [Surface] If sprint reports are rendered by a dedicated script, that script is the integration-test surface; otherwise integrate at the SKILL.md report-rendering step

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I surface design:fidelity_gap-tagged stories in sprint reports
